caseNameFull: Southern Paper Company v. Stokes V. Robertson, State Revenue Agent
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Mississippi.
attorneys: Mr. W. A. White for plaintiff in error. Mr. George Butter for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6,1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726.
